name: GLB Content Viewer
description: Viewer for 3D GLB/GLTF model content. Displays 3D models with Babylon.js, supports download, wireframe toggle, and auto-rotate. Ephemeral cell for viewing 3D content generated by 3D Mesh Prototyping Cell.

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

content_id.description: UUID of the persisted 3D content to display

relative_url.description: Relative URL for direct file serving via Runtime File Server (e.g. /runtime/user/.../mesh.glb)

_discovery.describe: Ephemeral cell for viewing 3D GLB/GLTF model content. Displays models via BabylonModelViewer shared component with wireframe toggle, auto-rotate, and grid display. Integrates with 3D Mesh Prototyping Cell through child cell relationship. Supports download via postMessage FILE_DOWNLOAD.
use_cases: View generated GLB content from 3D Mesh Prototyping Cell
Toggle wireframe and auto-rotate for inspection
View 3D content in isolation without generation controls
